requirements.title: Server-Tracked Sessions with List, Per-Session Revoke, and Log-Out-Everywhere
requirements.description: Every sign-in creates a server-tracked session record (SQLite + Redis hot state). Authenticated users can list their active sessions. Any session can be individually revoked via the preserved /api/v1/sessions/{id} contract or its Connect equivalent. 'Log out everywhere' revokes all sessions for a user atomically. Session revocation must propagate to Redis immediately so in-flight token checks reject revoked sessions without waiting for token expiry. The revoke contract that device-sync-hub calls must be preserved or delivered as a Connect equivalent in lockstep.
